description: Defines the BufferItemConsumer class, a consumer endpoint for BufferQueue in Android's graphics framework, allowing clients to access and manage buffer items, with methods for acquiring and releasing buffers, and setting buffer freed listeners.

classes.name: BufferItemConsumer
classes.description: A class that acts as a consumer endpoint for BufferQueue, enabling clients to access buffer items, set listeners for buffer freeing, and manage buffer acquisition and release.

classes.name: BufferFreedListener
classes.description: An interface for a callback that is invoked when a buffer is freed.

methods.name: BufferItemConsumer
methods.description: Constructor to create a BufferItemConsumer with specified parameters.

methods.name: setBufferFreedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified when a buffer is freed.

methods.name: acquireBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the next buffer from the queue, optionally waiting for fence.

methods.name: releaseBuffer
methods.description: Releases a buffer back to the queue for reuse.
